what: Codex drafter internal argv contract omits required launch-codex-exec --output and --timeout
scenario_or_breakage: The retired wrapper always passes --output "$_codex_raw" and --timeout "$TIMEOUT", and launch_codex_exec_main requires both. If the port follows only the listed internal args, argparse exits before Codex runs, so no raw output or token-record sidecar is produced.
suggested_fix: Add --output <raw-output> and --timeout <timeout> to the preserved internal-args list. Make the new internal-args test assert the full ordered call, including those flags.
